summary: v0.4 regression + new-feature E2E testing. 11/12 backend tests pass; all critical v0.4 UI flows pass (Bakery|Account tabs, closed-days picker with auto-save, AccountTab, password mismatch toast, wrong current-password toast, successful password change + re-login with new password, session persistence on reload, authed-redirect from / to /dashboard). ONE BACKEND BUG: JWT TTL is still 7 days in server.py (ACCESS_TTL_DAYS=7); spec v0.4 requires 30 days.

critical.issue: JWT exp is ~7 days, spec requires 30-day TTL. server.py line 33 has ACCESS_TTL_DAYS = 7 — should be 30.

action_items: Fix JWT TTL: in /app/backend/server.py change `ACCESS_TTL_DAYS = 7` to `ACCESS_TTL_DAYS = 30`. This is a one-line fix and directly addresses the v0.4 spec item 'Extended JWT TTL to 30 days'.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG: ACCESS_TTL_DAYS=7 contradicts the v0.4 feature 'Extended JWT TTL to 30 days'. Although the frontend already persists the token to localStorage so session-reload works, logged-in users will still be silently booted on day 8.

Profile update PUT /api/profile does NOT re-issue a new JWT when the email changes. Existing tokens encode 'email' in the payload but get_current_user only looks up by sub (id), so functionally fine — but the 'email' claim in the token becomes stale. Low priority.

Avatar size limit is enforced via raw string length (>1_400_000 chars). A 256px JPEG at quality 0.82 is ~25–60KB so the limit is generous, but base64 inflation (~1.37×) means ~1MB binary = ~1.4MB string — the 1.4M literal is OK, but comment in code says '~1MB cap' which is actually >1MB of binary. Cosmetic.
Dashboard.jsx now wraps auto-save debounce with Tabs/closed-days; auto-save correctly fires on closed-days toggle (verified 'All saved' within ~2s).
get_or_create_settings backfills closed_days=[] for legacy rows — good defensive migration.
Forecast still returns a positive 'predicted' on closed days (reference-only) with is_closed=true and closed_reason — matches spec.

rca of the issue: JWT TTL mismatch RCA: /app/backend/server.py line 33 — `ACCESS_TTL_DAYS = 7`. The v0.4 spec 'Extended JWT TTL to 30 days' was not applied to this constant. Reproduction: register a new user, decode the returned token's `exp` claim, compute `(exp - now)/86400` → 7.00 days (expected ~30). Fix: change the constant to 30. No other locations reference the TTL value.
